name: Pandharpur Darshan
subtitle: Cultural & Tourism Information Portal
description: A comprehensive digital guide and exploration platform for devotees and tourists visiting the holy city of Pandharpur. Features temple schedules, accommodation guides, interactive maps, and travel planning.
problem: Pilgrims and tourists visiting Pandharpur lacked a centralized real-time information system for temple darshan queues, accommodation booking, and local transport.
solution: Built a lightning-fast responsive portal providing real-time temple updates, downloadable itineraries, interactive routes, and multilingual verified emergency contacts.
keyFeatures: Real-time Temple Schedule & Festival Alerts
Interactive Pandharpur Pilgrimage Map & Geo-Routing
Verified Ashram & Hotel Directory with One-Click Dial
Offline-capable PWA support for low-bandwidth zones
architecture: Next.js 16 App Router, Tailwind CSS, Leaflet Maps, Edge Caching

name: StudyBuddy AI
subtitle: AI-Powered Learning & Doubt Resolution Assistant
description: An intelligent educational assistant designed to help students study smarter. Integrates AI reasoning to break down complex concepts, summarize notes, generate practice quizzes, and explain solutions step-by-step.
problem: Engineering students struggle with fragmented self-study resources and delayed doubt-resolution during late-night exam prep.
solution: Created an AI conversational tutor that parses uploaded syllabus notes, generates active-recall quizzes, and provides step-by-step algorithm breakdowns.
keyFeatures: Dynamic Question Generation from uploaded lecture PDF notes
Step-by-step DSA & Code logic explanation with time complexity analysis
Interactive Flashcard deck generation for revision
Multi-turn streaming chat with memory using Google Gemini API
architecture: Next.js App Router, Gemini 1.5 Flash API, Tailwind CSS, Vercel Serverless

name: AgroMitra
subtitle: AI Crop Diagnostic & Smart Advisory Platform
description: An AgriTech advisory system empowering Indian farmers with real-time leaf disease detection, weather-based irrigation alerts, and local mandi price forecasts.
problem: Crop yield losses due to untimely detection of crop pathogens and lack of localized vernacular advisory.
solution: Engineered a vision-based mobile-friendly diagnostic tool where farmers take a photo of an infected leaf to receive instant diagnosis, pesticide recommendations, and dosage in Marathi and Hindi.
keyFeatures: Image-based plant disease classification with 94%+ accuracy
Localized multilingual audio advisory in Marathi, Hindi, and English
Live APMC Mandi crop price trends and fair-value indicator
Smart irrigation alerts based on 7-day hyper-local rainfall forecast
architecture: React.js frontend, Flask/FastAPI ML microservice, PyTorch, Node.js gateway

name: Krishi Connect
subtitle: Direct Farmer-to-Consumer Agricultural Marketplace
description: A decentralized agricultural marketplace connecting rural producers directly with retail buyers and bulk restaurants, cutting out predatory middlemen.
problem: Smallholder farmers capture less than 30% of the final consumer price due to multi-layered distributor cartels.
solution: Built a transparent supply-chain order tracking platform where farmers list harvest quantities and negotiate bulk pricing with verified buyers directly.
keyFeatures: Real-time harvest listing and bidding system
Escrow payments and digital invoice generation
Integrated logistics booking and pickup status tracking
Quality grading certificates and verified farmer profiles
architecture: Next.js 16, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Razorpay API

name: GenZDay
subtitle: Modern Lifestyle & Trend Curation App
description: A trendy, engaging platform tailored for Gen-Z audiences featuring curated viral topics, dynamic mood trackers, daily inspirations, and interactive community polls.
problem: Cluttered social feeds causing cognitive fatigue and lack of positive mood-aligned content discovery.
solution: Crafted a vibrant, glassmorphic daily digital companion that matches daily quotes, playlists, and productivity micro-goals to user mood state.
keyFeatures: Mood-driven dynamic themes with responsive ambient glows
Interactive community polls with real-time voting charts
Curated daily tech and culture trend highlights
Personal habit streak badges with local storage persistence
architecture: React 18, CSS Glassmorphism, Firebase Firestore, Web Audio API

name: DharaCode (Kings Deck CMS)
subtitle: Real-time Database-Backed Developer Portfolio Engine
description: High-performance developer sanctuary with live Prisma PostgreSQL sync, custom personal vault, habit streak tracking, and interactive theme orchestration.
problem: Static portfolio templates quickly become outdated and require developer commits to update every single project, skill, or streak.
solution: Built a private, passcode-secured administrative OS ('Kings Deck') that orchestrates all portfolio data, custom markdown vault notes, weekly habit streaks, and live theme states in real time.
keyFeatures: Full dual-navbar standalone administrative dashboard
Dynamic project and category CRUD with live front-end reflection
Personal Vault with persistent folder management and note encryption
Habit streak engine with automated weekly Sunday score evaluation
architecture: Next.js 16, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL (Neon / Supabase), Next API Routes
